text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime-p99 > 3s for /v1/generate (5m window). SLO p99=1.5s breached. AlertID=SLO-INC-8712. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/latency?panelId=5
amanda: seeing p95 and p99 both spike around 15:40UTC, streaming tails show long stalls, a few client timeouts :/
sanjay: I'm oncall, joining. Any obvious customer impact? which tenants?
amanda: error-rate for streaming up ~0.6% (baseline 0.02%). Top affected client: acme-corp (mobile chat). Some requests stuck in STREAM_WRITE on host g2-022
sanjay: quick checklist: CPU/GPU hot? kvcache evictions? autoscaler thrash?
leo: GPU usage flat. Node CPU ok. kvcache_evictions metric jumped at 15:38. Logs show repeated eviction warnings: `WARNING kv_cache: eviction triggered size=1024->768`
amanda: grafana snapshots: p95 from 0.7s -> 1.9s, p99 1.3s -> 3.6s. Streaming stalls concentrated on longer contexts >512 tokens.
sanjay: mitigation proposals: 1) route a % of traffic to lite-model-v1 fallback (lower mem, lower latency) 2) temporarily disable continuous-batching for streaming endpoints 3) enable burst pool for dedicated tenants. @mayra can you flip route weight to 30% to fallback and disable batching?
mayra: ack, making changes now. Command: ```
# route change
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routes/modify -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"prod":70,"lite-model-v1":30}}'
# disable streaming batching
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/featureflags -d '{"continuous_batching_streaming":false}'
```
incident-bot: config-change applied by mayra. ChangeID=cfg-5421.
amanda: initial signal looks promising — p99 dropping to ~1.9s after route flip. error-rate for acme down 60% relative.
sanjay: good. keep monitoring - hold for 15m window. If p99 doesn't return under 1.5s we'll escalate to SRE (page) and open an incident postmortem. For now I'll own the triage.
mayra: I'll run detailed kvcache analysis and fetch eviction traces + pod-level Latin logs, posting results here. Also prepping a canary to route 10% of critical tenants back to prod once stable.
leo: note: long-tail tokens still show occasional stalls; follow up: check kernel network queues and gRPC backpressure metrics.
sanjay: thanks team. handing off active watch to mayra for next 45m. I'll stay reachable. Please DM if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
